headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title: 多家中小银行，逆势上调存款利率！最高超30个基点
headlines.summary: 8月以来，湖北、广东等地多家中小银行相继上调存款利率。进入8月，多地城商行、农商行及村镇银行公告，对挂牌存款利率或特色存款产品利率进行上调。总体来看，各家银行的上调幅度在10—33个基点（BP）之间。在宏观市场利率整体下行、银行业持续压降负债成本的背景下，多数中小银行下调了存款利率，因此前述“反其道而行之”的做法，引发市场关注。业内人士认为，此举有明显的阶段性揽储特征，不具备普适性，且与近期部分国有大行集体重启五年期大额存单并无直接关联。（券商中国）

headlines.title_en: Several small and mid-sized banks bucked the trend to raise deposit rates! Highest increase exceeds 30 basis points.
headlines.summary_en: Since August, several small and mid-sized banks in Hubei, Guangdong, and other regions have successively raised deposit rates. Entering August, many city commercial banks, rural commercial banks, and village banks announced increases to listed deposit rates or featured deposit product rates. Overall, increases range from 10 to 33 basis points (BP). Against the backdrop of falling macro market rates and continued bank cost reduction on liabilities, most small and mid-sized banks cut deposit rates, so the above counter-trend moves have drawn market attention. Industry insiders believe this reflects a clear phase-specific deposit-gathering strategy, is not broadly applicable, and is not directly linked to some large state-owned banks collectively resuming five-year jumbo CDs. (Securities Times China)

headlines.title: 胜蓝股份：首次回购85900股，成交总金额999.22万元
headlines.summary: 胜蓝股份公告，公司于2026年7月31日审议通过回购方案，拟使用自有资金及自筹资金以集中竞价交易方式回购公司A股股份，用于实施股权激励或员工持股计划、可转债转股，回购资金总额不低于1亿元且不超过2亿元，回购价格不超过195.18元/股。2026年8月10日，公司首次通过股份回购专用证券账户以集中竞价交易方式实施回购，回购股份数量85900股，占公司总股本的0.0525%，最高成交价121.57元/股，最低成交价113元/股，成交总金额999.22万元（不含交易费用）。

headlines.title_en: Shenglan Co., Ltd.: First buyback of 85,900 shares, total transaction amount of 9.9922 million yuan.
headlines.summary_en: Shenglan Co. announced that on July 31, 2026, it approved a buyback plan to repurchase A-shares via centralized competitive trading using self-owned and self-raised funds, for equity incentives or employee stock ownership plans and convertible bond conversion, with total repurchase funds of no less than RMB 100 million and no more than RMB 200 million, at a repurchase price not exceeding RMB 195.18 per share. On August 10, 2026, the company conducted its first repurchase through a dedicated securities account via centralized competitive trading, buying 85,900 shares, representing 0.0525% of total share capital, with the highest transaction price of RMB 121.57 per share, the lowest of RMB 113 per share, and total consideration of RMB 9.9922 million (excluding transaction fees).
